summary: COSCIENS Biopharma Inc., on Form 6-K, references a previously filed Schedule 13E-3 (Rule 13e-3 Transaction Statement, filed April 4, 2026, as amended) concerning a Share Capital Amendment and a planned SEC Reporting Suspension to deregister its common shares. The company seeks to reduce costs and transition to compliance under Rule 12g3-2(b) for foreign private issuers while maintaining Canadian reporting issuer status. No financial terms, premium, or price per share are disclosed in this filing. The board likely supports the going-private transaction. The announced insolvency of German subsidiaries adds complexity. Watch for TSX approval of the Share Capital Amendment and subsequent deregistration effectiveness.
